name: Hayyat Apps Solar Lead Calculator
author: hayyatapps

sections.description:
Turn website visitors into qualified solar leads. Hayyat Apps Solar Lead Calculator adds a beautiful, multi-step solar estimator to any page. Visitors enter their address and energy usage; the tool analyzes their roof with Google’s Solar API and instantly shows a personalized recommendation — recommended system size, peak sun hours, annual production, roof suitability and a 30-year savings projection — capturing their name, email and phone as an encrypted lead along the way.

Built for solar companies, installers and lead-gen agencies who want more booked consultations without paying per lead.

Add it anywhere with one shortcode:

[hayyat-solar-calc]

Two result formats — you choose

Not every solar business wants to show pricing up front. This plugin ships with two results templates, switchable in one click:

  1. Feasibility only — shows the recommended system size, peak sun hours, annual production and roof suitability, with no pricing — perfect if you’d rather have prospects contact you for a quote.
  2. Size + savings — everything above plus the full financial story: estimated cost, federal tax credit, cash vs. financing, ROI/payback and an interactive 30-year “cost of energy over time” chart.

Why installers love it

  • More leads, less friction — a guided, mobile-friendly wizard that feels effortless and converts.
  • Real roof data — Google Solar API sun-hour analysis, with a safe fallback when satellite data isn’t available.
  • Address autocomplete — fast Google Places search, proxied so your keys never appear in your page source.
  • Encrypted leads — every lead’s email & phone are stored AES-256 encrypted at rest.
  • Your leads, your data — browse leads in the dashboard, see every input and estimate, and export to CSV.
  • Fully brandable — customize colors, fonts, layout, every label, error messages and even the image on each step.
  • Show only what you want — hide or require any input (address, usage, rate, shading, battery, contact fields).
  • Tune the numbers — edit cost per watt, tax credit, finance rate/term, utility rates and escalation to match your market.
  • Theme-safe CSS — fully scoped so it never clashes with Astra, Divi, Elementor or any theme.
  • CRM ready — request a done-for-you CRM integration right from the dashboard.

Privacy & security first

The plugin holds no Google API keys in its code. All Google Solar/Places work is proxied server-to-server, so keys are never exposed in the browser. Add your own Google Solar & Places keys on the API Settings page (stored encrypted) to run entirely on your own account with no daily limit — the built-in Setup Guide walks you through it, or email support@hayyatapps.com and we’ll set it up for you.

Free vs. Pro

The Free plan includes the full calculator, encrypted lead capture (first 5 leads fully visible), currency selection and the result-template choice. Pro unlocks colors/fonts/layout, custom step images, editable labels & error messages, show/hide & required controls for every input, editable savings assumptions, full lead visibility, CSV export, and removes the “Powered by” link.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the hayyat-apps-solar-lead-calculator folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. (Recommended) Go to Solar Calculator → API Settings and add your Google Solar & Places API keys. See the built-in Setup Guide, or email support@hayyatapps.com for help.
  4. Open Solar Calculator → Settings to pick your result format, colors, labels, inputs and assumptions.
  5. Add the [hayyat-solar-calc] shortcode to any page or post.
  6. Watch your leads roll in under Solar Calculator → Leads.
sections.faq:
Do I need my own Google API keys?

You can try the calculator immediately using our shared keys, limited to 10 address and 10 solar lookups per day. For unlimited use, add your own free Google Solar & Places keys on the API Settings page — the built-in Setup Guide walks you through it.

Can I hide the pricing/savings?

Yes. Set the result template to Feasibility only and visitors see the recommended system size, sun hours, production and suitability — but no pricing — so they contact you for a quote.

Are my visitors’ details safe?

Yes. Email and phone are AES-256 encrypted at rest and only decrypted for the admin Leads screen. Your API keys are used server-side only and never exposed in your page source.

Can I choose which questions the calculator asks?

Yes. On the Inputs tab you can show/hide and require each field — address, energy usage, electricity rate, shading, battery and the contact fields.

How accurate are the estimates?

They use Google’s Solar API where available and a configurable sizing/savings model otherwise. They’re designed to set expectations and generate leads, not replace a professional assessment. Every financial assumption is adjustable (Pro).

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. All Google/calculation work runs via WordPress AJAX, so it works on cached pages.

  • Two result formats: feasibility only, or size + full savings.
  • Google Solar API roof analysis (proxied) with sun-hours fallback.
  • Google Places address autocomplete (proxied — no keys in the browser).
  • Encrypted lead capture with first-5 free masking, result & admin emails, CSV export.
  • Show/hide & required controls for every input; editable labels, error messages & step images.
  • Editable savings assumptions; color, font & layout customization.
  • 7-day Pro trial;
  • CRM Integration request and More Customizations pages.
